terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: All visual requirements are expressed as procedural geometry, material, camera, or lighting behavior.

referenceCamera.note: Perspective estimated visually for comparison; it is not survey calibration.

objectClass.notes: The front and visible left side are observed. Hidden elevations continue the same construction system conservatively.

reasoning: The silhouette combines a large gable prism, secondary gable, chimney, deep eaves, hanging sign, quest board, and props.
Repeated masonry, framing, tile, hardware, paper, and barrel systems create complex meso and micro density.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Identity depends on a closed roof volume, layered architecture, and facade accessories.

details.description: Raised post, rail, and brace network.

definitionOfDone: The model reads immediately as the reference guildhall and remains volumetric from non-reference views.
Both roofs are closed triangular-prism solids, never two rotated box slabs.
The factory returns a named action-ready THREE.Group with sole y=0 and facade +Z.

proceduralStrategy: Use BufferGeometry/ExtrudeGeometry closed triangular prisms for the main and secondary roofs.
Build the architecture as named groups in blockout, structural, form-refinement, and material stages.
Use deterministic repeated geometry for masonry, timber braces, tile courses, chains, notices, and barrels.
Use only generated geometry and procedural material variation; no facade or photo billboard.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: Inspect side-by-side reference and current render; critical semantic features must pass individually.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Review only the identity-defining systems visible in the current pass.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Reference, render, comparison sheet, layer scores, and critical feature scores.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Use the reference-matched camera for the primary comparison and orbit views for volume checks.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: Agent visual inspection informed by deterministic diagnostics.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: The reference is a stylized studio render; materials are visually sampled procedural approximations rather than inverse-rendered PBR maps.

lightingFromPhoto: Large soft neutral key light from upper-front-left defines the roof slopes and timber relief.
Broad low-intensity fill light from facade-right preserves stone and doorway shadow detail.
Subtle cool rim/environment light separates the roof silhouette; use ACES tone mapping at exposure near 1.0.
Soft contact shadow and ambient occlusion ground the plinth, board feet, and barrel soles on a neutral background.

actionReadiness.contract: Named structural and prop groups expose stable pivots and runtime metadata.
authoringRules: Place door pivot at hinge edge.
Place sign pivot at its suspension edge.
Keep detachable facade props in named groups.

assumptions: Hidden rear and right elevations continue the visible half-timber and masonry construction with reduced detail.
Building dimensions are relative world units inferred from the image rather than historical measurements.
Materials are stylized procedural approximations using MeshStandardMaterial; no source photo is projected onto geometry.
risks: Single-view uncertainty on rear roof intersections.
Dense roof tiles and masonry can raise mesh count unless geometries are shared.
The crossed-swords emblem must remain legible without becoming an oversized flat decal.
